data.name: Wicked Improvisation
data.description: The feral gnasher becomes more capable with improvised weapons and natural attacks. The feral gnasher gains a +%1 competence bonus on damage rolls when using natural attacks or improvised weapons while raging.  This increase is not precision damage and is thus multiplied on a critical hit.|FeralGnasherWickedImprovisationBonus
